country_data.feed_reference_source: US Grains & Bioproducts Council Africa Feed Price report; Botswana September 2026 country entry
country_data.feed_reference_note: National reference price for compound layer feed, not a farm-specific delivered quotation; kept separate from the calculator's benchmark production cost.
country_data.local_feed_reference_source: Botswana Public Procurement Regulatory Authority, Price Reference Guide for Animal Feed 2025; Gaborone locality
country_data.local_feed_reference_note: Official 2025 public-procurement reference prices for Gaborone: layer grower per 50kg bag and layer mash per 20kg bag. Dated feed-input references only; not current retail quotations or a complete annual layer cost. Kept separate from calculator assumptions.
country_data.national_poultry_sector_reference_source: Business Botswana Poultry Desk, Poultry Sector Preliminary Outlook (2024 production data; preliminary sector statistics)
country_data.national_poultry_sector_reference_note: National industry context only. The report's 2024 figures are preliminary and its fieldwork initially focused on commercial/large-scale operations; reported small-producer mortality is an industry estimate. These statistics are not farm-specific production assumptions, feed conversion ratios, selling prices or complete farm budgets. They are not used to overwrite calculator inputs.
country_data.ifad_layers_model_reference: Botswana Livestock Commercialisation Project (BoLCoP), IFAD Project Design Report No. 7326-BW, dated 22 October 2025; poultry-layers financial models for 50, 150, 250, 400 and 1,200 birds.
country_data.ifad_layers_model_data_quality_note: Botswana-specific project-design assumptions and financial models, not audited farm accounts or current retail/farmgate quotations. The 50-bird micro model includes 80% egg own-consumption, 15% chick mortality, 10% adult mortality, and a stated 25 eggs per hen annually; its annual egg output assumption is not representative of a standard commercial laying cycle. The model set uses differing scales and its income tables are incremental project benefits, not gross margins. Retain as supporting evidence only; do not populate calculator cost_per_unit, price_per_unit or production yield from these figures without reconciling model definitions and checking current local egg prices and feed costs.
